result.title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
result.summary: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 4 个 patch 级与 2 个 WSI 数据集上基准测试 9 个组织学基础模型和 6 个通用模型，考察 $D_4$ 几何测试时增强在具备旋转不变性的模型上是否仍有收益，并提出仅对高熵预测施加 TTA 的 entropy routing 以降低开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 组织学影像与 LVR 主线距离较远，但「按预测不确定性选择性分配额外计算」可能为 LVR 的动态计算与停止决策提供线索，且 patch 级增益无法迁移到 slide 级 MIL 的负结果可供核查多视图/多尺度证据聚合的可加性假设。
